reason: It's not open yet, so I can't read a single review or see how clean it actually is, and that's what I check before my toddler touches anything. $59 a month is a lot to commit to when storytime at the library is free and CoCo's is already an option.
objection: No reviews and no way to see the cleaning routine yet, so I can't tell if it's really any different from CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor. I'm not paying monthly for a place I haven't seen.
would_change_my_mind: A visible cleaning and sanitizing routine, plus a few weeks of good reviews from real parents after it opens. A free or cheap trial visit would also get me in the door.
